mapper.insert: INSERT INTO billing_cargo_snapshot (tracking_number, booking_id, shipper_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, cargo_type, weight_kg, projected_at, last_event_id) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{shipperId}, #{originUnLocode}, #{destinationUnLocode}, #{cargoType}, #{weightKg}, #{projectedAt}, #{lastEventId}) ON CONFLICT (tracking_number) DO UPDATE SET booking_id = EXCLUDED.booking_id, shipper_id = EXCLUDED.shipper_id, origin_unlocode = EXCLUDED.origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode = EXCLUDED.destination_unlocode, cargo_type = EXCLUDED.cargo_type, weight_kg = EXCLUDED.weight_kg, projected_at = EXCLUDED.projected_at, last_event_id = EXCLUDED.last_event_id
INSERT INTO billing_cargo_leg (tracking_number, leg_seq, load_unlocode, unload_unlocode) VALUES (#{trackingNumber}, #{legSeq}, #{loadUnLocode}, #{unloadUnLocode})
